articles.title: FAA grounds departing flights nationwide, citing air traffic communication system outage
articles.description: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."

articles.title: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
articles.description: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.

articles.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
articles.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
articles.description: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

articles.title: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
articles.description: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.

articles.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
articles.description: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance—2 habits that take 'a few seconds' can help you avoid similar traps
articles.description: Researchers from the Digital Inquiry Group say that two habits that take just "a few seconds up front" can help keep you from being "duped" online.

articles.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
articles.description: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

articles.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.description: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs looks to cash in on big IPOs twice. Anthropic’s historic deal is its next chance
articles.description: While co-leading the offering, Goldman also wants a shot at managing the billions of dollars in new wealth that the deal creates. It's not the only one.

articles.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
articles.description: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.

articles.title: What's ahead for AI financing after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang departs
articles.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation puts Nvidia’s AI financing strategy in focus as investors watch credit markets and neocloud exposure.

articles.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
articles.description: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield moves to 5.17% as traders weigh producer price report
articles.description: Treasury yields moved higher as investor expectations for a December rate hike by the Federal Reserve gain strength.

articles.title: They train people to avoid 'honeypot' scams—here are the common red flags they spot: 'It feels so good to be wanted'
articles.description: Corporate security firms train companies and their employees on strategies for being vigilant against honeypots, and other social engineering attacks.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.description: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.description: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

articles.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear Robinhood challenge to IPO information omission lawsuit
articles.description: The Trump administration had urged the Supreme Court to hear an appeal by Robinhood of a lower-court's decision to revive an investors' lawsuit over the IPO.

articles.title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
articles.description: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.
